GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled 6th 8 Lengths . Straightened Up 5-6 Lengths from the Leader /winner, worked Through for 2nd # sound/winner led
Slow Out 1 Lengths , Drifted Back 2nd last 16 Lengths 1000m, never in race # always out back
Jumped Ok Settled Just Off Mid-Field 6 Lengths . Straightened Up in Clear 3 Lengths off, chased hard taking over near 100m & dashing Clear # Far Too Good
Bit Slow Out Settled 2nd last 14 Lengths . Straightened Up some 7 Lengths from the Leader , steadied off heels approaching 200m, ran on well last 100m to finish 2nd # made good ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: mom steadied and shifted to the outside of a/r approaching the 200m. Was then hampered soon after when obliged to shift out and away from a/r, which laid out under pressure. Stwds quest to her tactics today, particularly in relation to her decision to shift to the outside of a/r in the straight when there appeared to be a run available to the inside of that mare, RE a/r had been inclined to lay in approaching that point and she had anticipated that it would continue to shift in that direction, and as such she elected to shift to the outside.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled worse than Mid Field 8 Lengths . began to work forward out Four Wide approaching 600m, Straightened Up 3 Lengths off but was laying in, Couldn'T Go On (rider reported mare raced flat & didn't handle quick backup) # couldn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 150m was inconvenienced when contacted and taken  wider. RR that the mare raced flat

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Drifted Back 3rd last 11 Lengths . Straightened Up 7-8 Lengths from the Leader , ran on late # got too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: RR that he was obliged to settle further back than  he had hoped on the mare due to the wide barrier.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled in second half Two Wide 8 Lengths 1000m, Hard Ridden but was working into the race Straightening Up , had a bumping duel at the 200m to try and get in Clear , continued to race tight to the line and looked bit stiff # touch unlucky
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: had difficulty obtaining clear ground from the entrance to the  straight, and then approaching the 200m shifted out in an attempt to improve and in doing so  made contact with a/r on a number of occasions prior to gaining clear  ground near the 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly Settled 6th 6 Lengths . angled off rail near 600m, was held up into Straight , got Clear @ 200m but was left a bit flatfooted, didn't look as if she could win but she came through to get the bob in on the line # overcame bother!
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: slow to begin. Had difficulty obtaining clear ground from near  the 500m until inside the 300m.
